lastCompletedStory.title: cam review and cam ship CLI thin-proxies

nextStoryContext: US-007 complete. cam review and cam ship are now thin-proxies routing to the live orchestrator via atomic send-keys, following the exact same pattern as cam plan (US-006). Both commands: detect live orchestrator via hasSession+orchestratorAlive; on hit, atomic send-keys with -l; on miss, bootstrap cam run --no-attach, waitForOrchestrator, then send-keys. parseReviewArgs and parseShipArgs exported from index.ts (no-args parsers: only --help/-h accepted). 28 new tests pass (review + ship), 878 total pass, typecheck clean. no-permission-mode-flag.test.ts still passes. Next story on this branch: check prd.json for highest-priority passes=false non-operator story.
